# Codes

This area groups the standardized medical and administrative coding systems used by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) to track clinical quality indicators for patients with atrial fibrillation. It encompasses the specific ICD-10 diagnosis codes for monitoring severe bleeding and ischemic strokes, ATC classifications for anticoagulant drug classes, SKS intervention codes for patient education, and the precise laboratory and procedure codes required to verify diagnostic workups like thyroid and kidney function tests or echocardiography exams. Together, these code definitions form the technical foundation for extracting and measuring healthcare quality data across Danish national registries.

## Pages

- [[entities/codes/diagnosis-codes/index|Diagnosis Codes]] — ICD-10 codes used to track safety outcomes, specifically severe bleeding events and ischemic strokes in anticoagulated patients.
- [[entities/codes/drug-classes/index|Drug Classes]] — Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification codes for tracking pharmacological treatments like oral anticoagulants.
- [[entities/codes/intervention-codes/index|Intervention Codes]] — SKS intervention codes documenting preventive care and structured patient education initiatives.
- [[entities/codes/laboratory-tests/index|Laboratory Tests]] — National and regional identifiers for measuring thyrotropin (TSH) and creatinine to fulfill diagnostic and safety monitoring requirements.
- [[entities/codes/procedure-codes/index|Procedure Codes]] — Registry codes identifying various types of echocardiography examinations to ensure timely diagnostic imaging.
